parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).
